******************************************************************
      * Program     : CBACT02C.CBL                                      
      * Application : CardDemo                                          
      * Type        : BATCH COBOL Program                               
      * Function    : Read and print card data file.                    
      ******************************************************************

      * All Rights Reserved.

      *                                                                 
      *    http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0                   
      *                                                                 
      * Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing,      
      * software distributed under the License is distributed on an     
      * "AS IS" BASIS, WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND,    
      * either express or implied. See the License for the specific     
      * language governing permissions and limitations under the License
      ******************************************************************
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.                                                 
       PROGRAM-ID.    CBACT02C.                                                 
       AUTHOR.        AWS.                                                      
                                                                                
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.                                                    
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.                                                    
       FILE-CONTROL.                                                            
           SELECT CARDFILE-FILE ASSIGN TO   CARDFILE                            
                  ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED                                       
                  ACCESS MODE  IS SEQUENTIAL                                    
                  RECORD KEY   IS FD-CARD-NUM                                   
                  FILE STATUS  IS CARDFILE-STATUS.                              
      *                                                                         
       DATA DIVISION.                                                           
       FILE SECTION.                                                            
       FD  CARDFILE-FILE.                                                       
       01  FD-CARDFILE-REC.                                                     
           05 FD-CARD-NUM                       PIC X(16).                      
           05 FD-CARD-DATA                      PIC X(134).                     
                                                                                
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.                                                 
                                                                                
      *****************************************************************         
       COPY CVACT02Y.                                                           
       01  CARDFILE-STATUS.                                                     
           05  CARDFILE-STAT1      PIC X.                                       
           05  CARDFILE-STAT2      PIC X.                                       
                                                                                
       01  IO-STATUS.                                                           
           05  IO-STAT1            PIC X.                                       
           05  IO-STAT2            PIC X.                                       
       01  TWO-BYTES-BINARY        PIC 9(4) BINARY.                             
       01  TWO-BYTES-ALPHA         REDEFINES TWO-BYTES-BINARY.                  
           05  TWO-BYTES-LEFT      PIC X.                                       
           05  TWO-BYTES-RIGHT     PIC X.                                       
       01  IO-STATUS-04.                                                        
           05  IO-STATUS-0401      PIC 9   VALUE 0.                             
           05  IO-STATUS-0403      PIC 999 VALUE 0.                             
                                                                                
       01  APPL-RESULT             PIC S9(9)   COMP.                            
           88  APPL-AOK            VALUE 0.                                     
           88  APPL-EOF            VALUE 16.                                    
                                                                                
       01  END-OF-FILE             PIC X(01)    VALUE 'N'.                      
       01  ABCODE                  PIC S9(9) BINARY.                            
       01  TIMING                  PIC S9(9) BINARY.                            
                                                                                
      *****************************************************************         
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.                                                      
           DISPLAY 'START OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBACT02C'.                    
           PERFORM 0000-CARDFILE-OPEN.                                          
                                                                                
           PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y'                                      
               IF  END-OF-FILE = 'N'                                            
                   PERFORM 1000-CARDFILE-GET-NEXT                               
                   IF  END-OF-FILE = 'N'                                        
                       DISPLAY CARD-RECORD                                      
                   END-IF                                                       
               END-IF                                                           
           END-PERFORM.                                                         
                                                                                
           PERFORM 9000-CARDFILE-CLOSE.                                         
                                                                                
           DISPLAY 'END OF EXECUTION OF PROGRAM CBACT02C'.                      
                                                                                
           GOBACK.                                                              
                                                                                
      *****************************************************************         
      * I/O ROUTINES TO ACCESS A KSDS, VSAM DATA SET...               *         
      *****************************************************************         
       1000-CARDFILE-GET-NEXT.                                                  
           READ CARDFILE-FILE INTO CARD-RECORD.                                 
           IF  CARDFILE-STATUS = '00'                                           
               MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT                                            
      *        DISPLAY CARD-RECORD                                              
           ELSE                                                                 
               IF  CARDFILE-STATUS = '10'                                       
                   MOVE 16 TO APPL-RESULT                                       
               ELSE                                                             
                   MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT                                       
               END-IF                                                           
           END-IF                                                               
           IF  APPL-AOK                                                         
               CONTINUE                                                         
           ELSE                                                                 
               IF  APPL-EOF                                                     
                   MOVE 'Y' TO END-OF-FILE                                      
               ELSE                                                             
                   DISPLAY 'ERROR READING CARDFILE'                             
                   MOVE CARDFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS                            
                   PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS                               
                   PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM                                   
               END-IF                                                           
           END-IF                                                               
           EXIT.                                                                
      *---------------------------------------------------------------*         
       0000-CARDFILE-OPEN.                                                      
           MOVE 8 TO APPL-RESULT.                                               
           OPEN INPUT CARDFILE-FILE                                             
           IF  CARDFILE-STATUS = '00'                                           
               MOVE 0 TO APPL-RESULT                                            
           ELSE                                                                 
               MOVE 12 TO APPL-RESULT                                           
           END-IF                                                               
           IF  APPL-AOK                                                         
               CONTINUE                                                         
           ELSE                                                                 
               DISPLAY 'ERROR OPENING CARDFILE'                                 
               MOVE CARDFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS                                
               PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS                                   
               PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM                                       
           END-IF                                                               
           EXIT.                                                                
      *---------------------------------------------------------------*         
       9000-CARDFILE-CLOSE.                                                     
           ADD 8 TO ZERO GIVING APPL-RESULT.                                    
           CLOSE CARDFILE-FILE                                                  
           IF  CARDFILE-STATUS = '00'                                           
               SUBTRACT APPL-RESULT FROM APPL-RESULT                            
           ELSE                                                                 
               ADD 12 TO ZERO GIVING APPL-RESULT                                
           END-IF                                                               
           IF  APPL-AOK                                                         
               CONTINUE                                                         
           ELSE                                                                 
               DISPLAY 'ERROR CLOSING CARDFILE'                                 
               MOVE CARDFILE-STATUS TO IO-STATUS                                
               PERFORM 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS                                   
               PERFORM 9999-ABEND-PROGRAM                                       
           END-IF                                                               
           EXIT.                                                                
                                                                                
       9999-ABEND-PROGRAM.                                                      
           DISPLAY 'ABENDING PROGRAM'                                           
           MOVE 0 TO TIMING                                                     
           MOVE 999 TO ABCODE                                                   
           CALL 'CEE3ABD' USING ABCODE, TIMING.                                 
                                                                                
      *****************************************************************         
       9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS.                                                  
           IF  IO-STATUS NOT NUMERIC                                            
           OR  IO-STAT1 = '9'                                                   
               MOVE IO-STAT1 TO IO-STATUS-04(1:1)                               
               MOVE 0        TO TWO-BYTES-BINARY                                
               MOVE IO-STAT2 TO TWO-BYTES-RIGHT                                 
               MOVE TWO-BYTES-BINARY TO IO-STATUS-0403                          
               DISPLAY 'FILE STATUS IS: NNNN' IO-STATUS-04                      
           ELSE                                                                 
               MOVE '0000' TO IO-STATUS-04                                      
               MOVE IO-STATUS TO IO-STATUS-04(3:2)                              
               DISPLAY 'FILE STATUS IS: NNNN' IO-STATUS-04                      
           END-IF                                                               
           EXIT.                                                                
                                                                                
      *
      * Ver: CardDemo_v2.0-25-gdb72e6b-235 Date: 2025-04-29 11:01:27 CDT
      *

CARDFILE-FILE.b: VSAM KSDS card master file, accessed sequentially ordered by CARD-NUM primary key
CARDFILE-FILE.j: CardRepository extends JpaRepository<CardRecord, String> — table card_records

FD-CARDFILE-REC.b: FD record buffer for CARDFILE-FILE: 150-byte working area populated by each READ
FD-CARDFILE-REC.j: CardRecord entity — @Entity @Table(name="card_records"); all sub-fields are mapped columns

FD-CARD-NUM.b: Primary KSDS record key: 16-character card number in the raw FD buffer

FD-CARD-DATA.b: Remaining 134 bytes of the raw FD record buffer (all data after FD-CARD-NUM)
FD-CARD-DATA.j: No direct Java field — CardRecord uses the structured CVACT02Y copybook fields instead

CARD-RECORD.b: 01-level copybook group (CVACT02Y): all card sub-fields concatenated; 150 bytes total
CARD-RECORD.j: CardRecord @Entity — JPA entity with 6 persisted fields from CVACT02Y layout

CARD-NUM.b: 16-character card number — primary KSDS key and globally unique card identifier

CARD-ACCT-ID.b: 11-digit account ID that links this card record to an account in ACCTFILE

CARD-CVV-CD.b: 3-digit card verification value (CVV/CVC) — PIC 9(03) stored zero-padded
CARD-CVV-CD.j: CardRecord.cardCvvCd (String) — CHAR(3) preserving leading zeros; not for production persistence

CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME.b: Cardholder name as printed on the card face — left-justified, space-padded to 50 chars

CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE.b: Card expiration date in 10-char string format (typo "EXPIRAION" preserved from CVACT02Y)

CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS.b: Single-char card lifecycle status: Y=active/valid, N=inactive/cancelled

CARDFILE-STATUS.b: 2-char VSAM file status code returned by the OS after each READ/OPEN/CLOSE operation
CARDFILE-STATUS.j: No Java field — Spring Batch propagates I/O failures as exceptions with JDBC error codes

CARDFILE-STAT1.j: No Java equivalent — exception type encodes the error category

CARDFILE-STAT2.b: Right status byte: additional VSAM/QSAM detail sub-code qualifying CARDFILE-STAT1
CARDFILE-STAT2.j: No Java equivalent — exception cause and message encode detail

IO-STATUS.b: Working copy of CARDFILE-STATUS used for display formatting in 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS
IO-STATUS.j: No Java equivalent — exception.toString() provides equivalent diagnostic text

IO-STAT1.b: Left byte of IO-STATUS (copy of CARDFILE-STAT1) used for NNNN format display

IO-STAT2.b: Right byte of IO-STATUS (copy of CARDFILE-STAT2) — moved to TWO-BYTES-RIGHT for int decode

TWO-BYTES-BINARY.b: PIC 9(4) BINARY overlay — receives TWO-BYTES-RIGHT byte to convert non-numeric status byte to integer
TWO-BYTES-BINARY.j: No Java equivalent — standard COBOL BINARY byte-to-int conversion pattern (ANS-85)

TWO-BYTES-ALPHA.b: REDEFINES TWO-BYTES-BINARY — provides byte-addressable alphanumeric view for status byte extraction
TWO-BYTES-ALPHA.j: No Java equivalent — COBOL REDEFINES overlay has no Java parallel

TWO-BYTES-LEFT.b: High byte of TWO-BYTES-ALPHA (not used in this program — placeholder in the layout)

TWO-BYTES-RIGHT.b: Low byte of TWO-BYTES-ALPHA — receives IO-STAT2 to allow binary integer conversion for DISPLAY

IO-STATUS-04.b: 4-character display buffer: formatted file status in NNNN layout for 9910-DISPLAY-IO-STATUS output
IO-STATUS-04.j: No Java equivalent — Spring Batch logs exception class, message and stack trace automatically

IO-STATUS-0401.b: First digit of the IO-STATUS-04 composite display field (PIC 9)

IO-STATUS-0403.b: Remaining 3 digits of the IO-STATUS-04 display field (PIC 999) holding the numeric detail code

APPL-RESULT.j: No Java field — ItemReader.read() returns null for EOF; throws on error

APPL-AOK.b: 88-level condition: APPL-RESULT = 0, meaning the last READ completed successfully
APPL-AOK.j: No Java equivalent — maps to non-null return value from RepositoryItemReader.read()

APPL-EOF.b: 88-level condition: APPL-RESULT = 16, meaning CARDFILE-STATUS = "10" (end of file)
APPL-EOF.j: No Java equivalent — maps to RepositoryItemReader.read() returning null

END-OF-FILE.b: Loop-termination flag PIC X(01): initialised "N"; SET to "Y" when APPL-EOF fires to exit PERFORM UNTIL
END-OF-FILE.j: No Java field — Spring Batch chunk loop terminates when ItemReader.read() returns null

ABCODE.b: Abend code passed to CEE3ABD on fatal error; always 999 in this program
ABCODE.j: No Java field — CardFileException message string encodes the error context

TIMING.b: CEE3ABD timing parameter: 0 = take immediate abend dump
TIMING.j: No Java equivalent — RuntimeException propagation is inherently synchronous
